relevance_note: Case report of an individual with arterial tortuosity syndrome and a homozygous SLC2A10 variant, plus a literature table of 21 published ATS patients: "We report a patient with ATS carrying a homozygous nonsense variant, c.485G > A (p.Trp162Ter)".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a Python script in the scratch directory assembled the JSON from values and quotes I chose, and asserted that every quote is a substring of the paper and that every Table 1 quote lies on that patient's own row. Scope: 26 people = P22 (the paper's own case; Table 1 PN label 'P22', 'Our case'), 21 previously published patients P1-P21 from the literature table (Table 1, PN column), and four relatives of P22 (deceased sibling with tetralogy of Fallot, untested = 'sibling of P22'; phenotypically unaffected heterozygous sibling = 'sibling of P22 2'; heterozygous mother and father). Table 1 'Sex/Age' was recorded as sex plus age at last evaluation (the table does not say what the age refers to); 'diagnosis at N years' went to age at diagnosis. Table 1 Reference cells were copied to source_reference_in_review; family/patient labels from the source papers (e.g. 'Family 1, IV:4') were left inside that cell, not in family_label_in_paper. Variant type and zygosity for compound-heterozygous rows were taken from the ordered 'Missense + nonsense' style cell of the same row, matched to the variants in the order printed; the transcript NM_030777.4 comes from the column header. The CS column of Table 1 is the current ClinVar clinical significance looked up by the authors via VarSome ('Current ClinVar clinical significance was recorded using VarSome searches'), not the authors' own classification, so pathogenicity_as_stated_by_authors was left 'not reported' for P1-P21. For P22 the table gives 'P(PVS1,PM2,PP5)' and the methods say classification followed ACMG/AMP 2015, but the text says it was 'classified as pathogenic according to the current ClinVar clinical significance displayed in VarSome'; recorded 'pathogenic' with both quotes. Phrases such as 'were not reported', 'were not reported as present' and 'NR' were treated as not reported; 'were absent', 'were not observed', 'was not detected', 'without ...' and 'No ...' were treated as excluded. 'Joint and ocular involvement were not observed' (P6) was recorded as excluded broad features only, without excluding the narrower checklist item joint hypermobility. 'Pulmonary arterial hypertension ... absent' (P17-P20) was used to exclude the checklist item pulmonary hypertension. 'Aortic root dilation', 'annuloaortic ectasia' and 'aortic sinus dilatation' were counted as aortic root aneurysm on the checklist; 'joint laxity'/'patellar hyperlaxity' as joint hypermobility; 'pectus deformity' as pectus excavatum or carinatum; Morgagni hernia, diaphragmatic hernia and hiatal hernia as diaphragmatic or hiatal hernia; renal artery stenosis as stenosis of an aortic branch. Hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (P22), diffuse ischemic brain changes (P11) and TIAs (P14) were not counted as stroke or ischemic organ infarction; 'No stroke' (P16) did not exclude the composite stroke-or-infarction item. P22 inheritance left 'not reported': both parents are stated heterozygous carriers of a homozygous variant, which the inheritance enum (single parent) cannot express; the parental statement is in parental_testing_statement. 'Novel' variant (Introduction, Results) vs 'this variant was previously submitted to ClinVar' (Discussion). Contradictions/oddities: the qRT-PCR paragraph says primers flank 'the c.2836C > T variant', which does not match c.485G > A; Figure 5 legend refers to 'siblings' while the text says the samples were the proband, both parents and an unrelated control; the deceased sibling 'died with' (text) vs 'died of' (Table 1) tetralogy of Fallot; P22's age at last evaluation (12 months) comes only from Table 1. No stacked ' / ' cells in this paper. n_patients_reported left null: the authors do not state a total number of SLC2A10 patients described (one own case plus 21 literature cases in Table 1).
